# Maddison Project Database: version 2023

The [Groningen Growth and Development Centre (GGDC)](https://www.rug.nl/ggdc/historicaldevelopment/maddison/releases/maddison-project-database-2023)
publishes long-run country-level estimates of output, income and population.
The **2023 release** covers **169 countries** with observations extending
through **2022**. The source files are distributed by [DataverseNL](https://doi.org/10.34894/INZBF2)
in Excel and Stata formats.

## Research use

`portugal-living-standards-reassessment` lists long-run GDP per capita
and population as planned data for a comparison of Portuguese and
European living-standard trends. No versioned Maddison dataset has yet
been imported or pinned by that project.

When acquiring data, record the exact **2023 release**, downloaded file
SHA-256, relevant price and PPP benchmark, GDP-per-capita measure, country
codes, country/sample selection, time coverage, missing-data handling,
and whether observations were extrapolated or reconstructed. Do not
splice 2018, 2020 and 2023 revisions without a documented crosswalk.

The intended descriptive work should compare both **starting levels** and
**annualized pre/post growth rates**, while distinguishing Western
European post-war recovery from Portugal's starting conditions. Maddison
series are contextual economic estimates, not a counterfactual estimate
of democracy's or the SNS's health effects.

## Release-specific licence and source citation

The University of Groningen expressly licenses **version 2023** under
[CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Its release
page imposes an additional attribution requirement:

1. For **any graph**, cite **all original source papers** associated with
   the data used, as listed on the workbook's source sheet.
2. For **subsets with fewer than 12 countries**, likewise cite those
   original source papers, even when the data are used only for analysis.
3. In other cases, cite the MPD as a whole, following GGDC guidance.

Core citation: Bolt, J., & van Zanden, J. L. (2024). *Maddison style
estimates of the evolution of the world economy: A new 2023 update*.
*Journal of Economic Surveys*. [DOI:10.1111/joes.12618](https://doi.org/10.1111/joes.12618).

The terms concern the 2023 database and do not establish licensing for
every older Maddison release or third-party derivative. This registry
contains only metadata and authoritative links.
